page.overview:
Who is M.A.R.S. Trooper?

M.A.R.S. Troopers were M.A.R.S. Industries soldiers. They were led by M.A.R.S. Trooper Officers.

The M.A.R.S Troopers are analogous to the Iron Grenadier Troopers.
